intro: Lesson 39. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ شَهِيدٌ (٩) إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا۟ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا۟ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ ٱلْحَرِيقِ (١٠) إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتٌۭ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ (١١)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: To whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And Allah, over all things, is Witness.
Indeed, those who have tortured the believing men and believing women and then have not repented will have the punishment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the Burning Fire.
Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great attainment.

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Burooj 85:9-11 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 85:9-11 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 85:9-11 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Recite Al-Burooj 1 to 11 to a partner.
Which two signs are in 85:9 to 11, and what do they allow?
questions.a: ۚ after «وَٱلْأَرْضِ» and after «ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ»: stopping and continuing are equal.
A) Gardens beneath which rivers flow. 85:11.

questions.q: Al-Burooj 85:11: «إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: Allah promises gardens with rivers to those who believe and do good (85:11). What good deed could you do this week to work towards that?
questions.a: For example: pray on time, be kind to my family, help a neighbour.
